:::{#exr-matvec-linear-practice}
#### Applying a matrix to a combination without knowing the matrix

@thm-matvec-linear lets a [matrix-vector product](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matvec-mult) of a combination
be found from the matrix-vector product of each part,
even when the [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) itself is not known.
Suppose that a matrix $\matr{A}$ satisfies

$$
\matr{A}\vecf{z}_1 = \sbmat{1 \\ 2},
\qquad
\matr{A}\vecf{z}_2 = \sbmat{0 \\ -1}.
$$

Find $\matr{A}\,(3 \vecf{z}_1 + 2 \vecf{z}_2)$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @thm-matvec-linear with $c_1 = 3$ and $c_2 = 2$.

:::

:::
